A tall folding enclosure screen behind the diners; exactly two translucent warm sheep-horn style hanging lamps above the enclosure, with partial rows of small gold lotus lanterns extending beyond the crop along both gate sides; do not attempt to show every lantern. At the distant opening exactly TWO guards, one on either side, each holding a simple horizontal barrier pole, keeping a small crowd of bundled onlookers beyond the banquet space. No snow, no summer leaves, no modern fireworks machinery, no invented ceremonial weapon. The composition is candid, unequal access to the festivities is legible through the poles and screen.
